flows.title: Create a workflow
steps: Select the create button in the upper-left corner of the side menu, then select workflow.
If your n8n instance supports projects, choose whether to create the workflow inside your personal space or a specific project you have access to.
Get started by adding a trigger node: select Add first step.

flows.title: Run a workflow manually
steps: Open the workflow you want to run on the workflow canvas.
Run a workflow this way while building and testing, or when the workflow has no trigger node.

flows.title: Publish a workflow so it runs automatically
steps: Open your workflow. All new workflows are unpublished by default.
Click Publish. A workflow that starts with a trigger node or a Webhook node must be published before it can run automatically.
A published workflow runs whenever its trigger conditions are met. The option to unpublish is in the workflow settings menu.
